svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the bars to the spine foot first, in a jig that holds

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: their trunk-side faces at 120 deg and 50 high from the foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4 mm fillets all round each bar end; the bar ends must not

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stand proud of the spine's front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Then the four eye rings, then the two cheeks.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the V faces meet (if extended) 8 in front of the spine

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front edge; both bar faces flat within 1 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grind spatter off the bar faces and slots. Galvanise the whole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: frame; afterwards run a 7 mm bar through both slots and the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 8 pin through its hole to clear the zinc.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stamp SWL 100 kg ONE PERSON and the frame number on the spine.
